report.answer_text: Baby KJ Muldoon received a personalised CRISPR base-editing therapy designed to correct a specific mutation in his *CPS1* gene. The editor was delivered to his liver cells in lipid nanoparticles to treat severe carbamoyl phosphate synthetase 1 (CPS1) deficiency, a rare disorder that causes toxic ammonia to build up in the blood. He received his first dose in February 2025. (chop.edu)
